_source: Colors: Extron's Afterburn theme guide, transcribed in docs/design-rules.md section 4; `alert` from the seed's own buttons.
Type, borders, button archetypes and sizes: surveyed off seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl (its fonts, border resources and every button's per-state fill, stroke and text color).
Point sizes draw at 1.375 px per point, GUI Designer's 99 DPI (gdl/compose.py PT).
title: Extron Afterburn
tagline: Extron's Afterburn touch-panel template, for TLP Pro panels.

colors.name: raised
colors.usage: Button fill when idle; panels and cards; a slider or level track over a color.

colors.name: pressed
colors.usage: Button fill when pressed or selected (the On state). The same value as page.

colors.name: text
colors.usage: Headings, button captions, paragraphs; the border of a pressed outlined button. On page, raised and pressed.

colors.name: text-secondary
colors.usage: Subheadings, date and time, divider lines, the border of an idle outlined button, a slider's fill, single-color icons. On page and raised.

colors.name: text-subtle
colors.usage: De-emphasised icon parts and disabled captions. Under 4.5:1 on page and raised, so not for text people have to read: the guide's value, kept.

colors.name: shape
colors.usage: Container shapes and outlines; a toggle's thumb when off.

colors.name: accent
colors.usage: Selection lines and selected icons; a caption that marks an active state. One scheme per project.

colors.name: accent-2
colors.usage: A toggle or slider thumb and a level's fill. One scheme per project.

colors.name: alert
colors.usage: A caption or fill that warns: a fault, an active mute. From the seed's own buttons, not the guide.

colors.name: scrim
colors.usage: Behind a modal popup's card: page at 20% transparency, as the guide words it.

type.name: title
type.usage: A page's title - the seed's largest label.

type.name: heading
type.usage: A popup's or a section's heading.

type.name: button-large
type.usage: The caption of a large button: a source, a main action.

type.name: body
type.usage: Labels, status and paragraphs; the clock.

type.name: body-strong
type.usage: A label that names a group of controls.

type.name: button
type.usage: The caption of a small button. Afterburn's own small buttons use 13 pt, under the 14 pt minimum the toolkit checks, so 14 is the floor here.

afterburn.usage: An outlined button: rounded, with its stroke drawn.

afterburn-flat.usage: A rounded fill with no stroke: ghost buttons, panels, cards.

rect.usage: A square-cornered fill: a full-width bar.

outlined.usage: The default button: a raised fill and a text-secondary border, pressed fill and a white border when On. The seed's most common look.

ghost.usage: No fill until pressed or selected: list rows, tabs, icon buttons.

inverse.usage: For a button sitting on a raised panel: pressed fill when idle, raised when On.

cover.pattern: rounded tiles cut at the Afterburn 10 px radius
